title: Has Microsoft Lost Its Mojo (Again)?
author: Steven Levy
content_snippet: Microsoft’s AI products aren’t selling, and Github’s been plagued with troubles. WIRED spoke with VP Scott Hanselman about whether the company is in catch-up mode.
